ar: أبو الفتح عثمان بن جني الموصلي

description.tr: En büyük Arapça morfolojist; analizi modern üretken dilbilgisini önceden haber verdi || el-Hasâis Arap dilbiliminde en özgün eserdir. || [Tarih notu] İstiknâ teorisi Saussure'ün kavramıyla paraleldir.
description.en: Greatest Arabic morphologist; his analysis anticipated modern generative grammar || His Khasais is the most original work in Arabic linguistics — proposing language is an organic, evolving system. || [Historiographical note] His theory of istigna parallels Saussure's concept of the arbitrary linguistic sign.
